response.sql: WITH obs_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), total_telescopes AS (SELECT SUM(telescope_count) as total FROM obs_counts), obs_shares AS (SELECT oc.observstation, oc.telescope_count, CAST(oc.telescope_count AS NUMERIC) / CAST(tt.total AS NUMERIC) as share FROM obs_counts oc CROSS JOIN total_telescopes tt), avg_share_val AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM obs_shares) SELECT AVG(os.telescope_count) as avg_telescope_count, AVG(os.share) as avg_share, AVG(os.share - asv.avg_share) as avg_above_average FROM obs_shares os CROSS JOIN avg_share_val asv WHERE os.share > asv.avg_share;
